card.name: Peacock Dance of the Dai
card.tagline: Graceful Dai dance mirroring the sacred peacock
card.profile: The Peacock Dance (孔雀舞, Kongque wu) is the most famous folk dance of the Dai people of Yunnan, imitating the movements of the peacock, a Dai totem of auspiciousness and beauty (English Wikipedia; CITS). Traditional forms include a heavy bamboo-and-silk peacock-frame dance and an 'unarmed' version, accompanied by elephant-foot drums, gongs and cymbals. It features flexible knees and expressive arm, wrist and finger work, performed at festivals such as Water-Splashing.
card.insight: Listed in 2006 in China's first batch of national intangible cultural heritage, it embodies Dai spiritual values and was made world-famous by dancer Yang Liping (China Odyssey Tours; English Wikipedia).
